name: 4 Grid Acrylic Seasoning Spice Box Kit with Spoon Kitchen Masala Container Seasoning Organizers Crystal Spice Box, For Kitchen
description:
Product Type: Crystal Seasoning Box

Material: High-quality acrylic, keeps spices fresh, odor-free, and dust-free

Size: 26 × 10.2 × 8 cm

Convenient: Comes with a removable tray for easy cleaning and storage; anti-corrosive design

Multi-purpose: Perfect for storing pepper, sugar, salt, spices, chicken broth powder, corn starch, and more

Advantage: Transparent design saves space and keeps your kitchen neat and organized

Marketed By: G & E BD

Country of Origin: P.R.C.

Description:
Organize your kitchen in style with this 4-grid transparent acrylic seasoning box set. Durable and easy to clean, it keeps your spices fresh and accessible while saving space. Ideal for storing a variety of condiments, this spice jar set combines practicality with a sleek design, making your kitchen look neat and tidy.
